extracted.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
extracted.description: Great recipe for Chicken Tortilla Soup.
ingredient_lines: 2 Packets Sazon Goya Con Culantro Y Achiote
1 Packet Sazon Goya Con Cilantro Y Tomato
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in large pot. Once heated, add garlic, onion & jalapeños. Heat until softened.
Add chicken and all powder seasonings. Mix well. Cook chicken thoroughly.
Add cilantro, crushed tomatoes, black beans & Rotel. Mix & bring to a mild simmer.
Add chicken broth. Bring to a boil, the lower heat, and simmer for 1 hour.
